caption: The drawing features a rectangular section of a textile pattern, centered on a plain, slightly off-white background. The textile portion is composed of a grid with a woven texture, filled with intricate floral and botanical shapes. The main colors in the textile are a muted red and a medium blue, arranged in a way that the red and blue areas seem to alternate and interlock, forming distinct floral motifs and leaf-like elements. The background of the textile is a beige or light brown, acting as a neutral canvas for the colored designs. Around the textile sample, the background is mostly empty except for scattered small brownish spots that give the appearance of staining or aging. The lower right area of the sheet contains a small, handwritten signature in a dark ink.
title: Coverlet (Section)
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
